data.reason_zh: 以反馈驱动的原子规则编辑与技能状态树搜索迭代改进外部技能，并保留状态供后续扩展，符合方法类RSI。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Contrastive atomic editing links each primitive rule edit to failed and successful executions, a behavioral hypothesis, and an intended scope.
scope_support.object_quote: Agent skills adapt frozen models through editable external instructions.
scope_support.persistence_quote: Skill-State Tree Search (STS) evaluates short edit compositions and selectively retains them as executable states that can be revisited and extended.
